description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different knowledge sources used by large language models. There are five categories shown: TriviaQA, HalluQA, HalluEval, Chinese Domain, and an unnamed category. TriviaQA has the largest share with 46% (1829 instances), followed by HalluEval with 18% (721 instances), HalluQA with 5% (185 instances), and Chinese Domain with 6% (231 instances). The unnamed category accounts for 25% (997 instances). The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and a legend in the upper right corner. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
